attributes.description: S H Kelkar and Company Limited is engaged in manufacture, supply and exports of fragrances and aroma ingredients[1] It is the largest domestic fragrance producer in India and the only company of Indian origin to file patents in the field of Fragrance & Novel aroma molecules.
